import pandas as pd

# Load source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_75/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_75/training_1.csv"

Source3_75_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source3_75_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
joined = pd.merge(Source3_75_0, Source3_75_1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by [Source3_75_0.city, Source3_75_1.type], aggregations = avg(Source3_75_0.fare)
# Group by city and type, aggregate average fare
grouped = (
    joined.groupby(["city", "type"], as_index=False)
    .agg({"fare": "mean"})
)

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
grouped = grouped.rename(columns={"fare": "fare"})

# Ensure column order as per target schema: ['city', 'type', 'fare']
grouped = grouped[["city", "type", "fare"]]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_75/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_75/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_75/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city' (inner join by default)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' (the primary key) and 'type' is functionally dependent on city, so only group by city
# Aggregate average fare
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({"fare": "mean"})

# Add 'type' column back by taking the first non-null 'type' per city (since city -> type is FD)
# We can get 'type' from source1 since it has unique city->type mapping
type_map = source1.set_index("city")["type"]
result["type"] = result["city"].map(type_map)

# Reorder columns to match target schema: ['city', 'type', 'fare']
result = result[["city", "type", "fare"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_75/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
